Subject: POC timeline & milestones - Acme Industries (follow-up)

Hi Jordan / Sana —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the trial: 

Summary of what we discussed:
- Objective: validate Redwood inference for Acmes customer-facing search ranking pipeline and reduce per-query cost by at least 30% while keeping quality within +/-1% of current baseline.
- Proposed POC scope: indexing and reranking for a representative customer segment (~50k queries/day), dataset snapshot + sample prompts provided by Acme.

Draft success criteria (attached as POC_Success_Criteria_v1.xlsx):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 120ms for ranked responses under target load.
- Cost: token cost per query reduced by >=30% vs current infra.
- Quality: NDCG@10 >= baseline -1% across evaluation set; no critical regressions on top-3 results.
- Reliability: sustained throughput for 2-hour soak at expected load spikes.

Proposed timeline & milestones (high level):
1) Kickoff & environment access (Week 0) — agree on data transfer method, Redwoods infra contact (Vivek) and Acme infra contact (Sana) handshake.
2) Baseline ingest & smoke test (Week 1) — Redwood demo environment with sample dataset.
3) Model tuning & run evaluations (Weeks 2-3) — iterate on quantization/batching config.
4) Soak & final readout (Week 4) — performance/cost/QA review and next-step decision.

Proposed kickoff: Wednesday, Mar 3, 2027, 10:00-11:00 PT. Attached is a short kickoff agenda (PocKickoff_Agenda.pdf).

Owners:
- Redwood: Marissa (commercial/coordination), Vivek (infra/privileged access), Monica (CS onboarding & success).
- Acme: Jordan (product), Sana (infrastructure lead).

Next steps:
- Jordan/Sana: confirm kickoff time and owner contacts, and share S3 access or dataset transfer preference.
- Marissa: schedule kickoff and share calendar invites + agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0112
